thienone.definition:
n. A ketone derivative of thiophene obtained as a white
   crystalline substance, (C4H3S)2.CO, by the action of aluminium chloride
   and carbonyl chloride on thiophene.

thienyl.definition:
n. The hypothetical radical C4H3S, regarded as the essential
   residue of thiophene and certain of its derivatives.

thier.definition:
comparative of thy
pron. Of thee, or belonging to thee; the more common form of
   thine, possessive case of thou; -- used always attributively, and
   chiefly in the solemn or grave style, and in poetry. Thine is used in
   the predicate; as, the knife is thine. See Thine.
